title: Beowulf, Lines 26–50
subtitle: The funeral of Scyld — the ship-burial.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Old English poetry and prose.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body:
Þā wæs on burgum Bēowulf Scyldinga,
lēof lēodcyning, longe þrāge...

'Then in the strongholds was Beowulf of the Scyldings, beloved people-king, for a long time...'

The funeral of Scyld. Poetic vocabulary (ȳþ-geblond = wave-tumult; sǣ-gēap = sea-curved). Full close reading.
